lattice_definition: anchor in-page offset = (FAR_SEG*16 + anchor IP) & 0FFh; from a trail word (IP,CS) of a 2-byte self-call: (CS*16 + IP - 2) & 0FFh. rev0 = 52h. Undercut window: opponent lattice 0F2h..42h (10h-60h below 52h), same MOVSB trigger family (pushed IP low byte A4h).

prevalence.method: static scan of every binary (scratch/B065/lattice.mjs -> lattice.txt: mov al,imm x segment-like immediates; scan.mjs -> scan2025.txt) plus trail words recovered from fatal-byte records of the 3 existing trace dirs (scratch/B065/trailwords.mjs)
prevalence.f2025: 150 warriors, 82 contain a far call/jmp. Most replicators are MOVSW-type (AL A1h/A3h; lattices A1h/C1h/E1h/03h/E3h/F3h; e.g. cgx123123, Code_Killer, Baltika9, TrojanByte, K0F1M, B33, YOY, ByteReapers, TOMEX, 3Plate_Benchers) - a different mechanism (B051 anchor kill), not domain 5. MOVSB-type (A4 trigger): GGN_OpcodeHunter2 (FAR_SEG = 1000h - dl, dl = ((loadlow|1) mod 10)+1 -> lattice 82h/62h/42h/22h/02h chosen once per battle from the load address; 3 of 5 values are 10h/30h/50h below rev0; confirmed by trace trail words CS 0FF6/0FF8/0FFA/0FFC/0FFE with IP low A4), GSA_VanLavan2 (A2h, 50h above), GSA_callfart (D2h), OST_Gamma1 (A2h, trace), HRZ_Registered_Winners (62h = 10h above; rev0 undercuts it). SKYENT (AL 71h, FAR_SEG 0FFDh -> 41h) is MOVSW-type (odd AL), not in-family.
prevalence.f2024_l2024_f2023: No MOVSB-family undercutter found statically: TOM_R_JS (A2h), S3gm3ntati0n_cu1t2 (6Ah, above), PastRAMa (11h/41h but AL A1h = MOVSW-type), Code_Killers F24 (AL A9/A0/B0, not A4 family). Many 2024 entries compute the segment at run time (static unknown).
prevalence.peers_and_library: zrl03 and ah02 (lead_zrl03/lead_ah02, P_zrl03 in strong cohort sstrong-4): FAR_SEG 0FF9h, AL A2h -> 32h = 20h below rev0 (the only systematic undercutters found). Chimera/m050, b01d, e1p4, K_FixedToggle, K_Synthesis: 0FFCh -> 62h (rev0 undercuts them by 10h). zchain4, V6, V4, V6Guard: 52h (same). Field S cohorts with an in-window undercutter: s2025-10 and 2 threat cohorts (OpcodeHunter, 3/5 of loads), sstrong-4, sthreat-lead_zrl03, sthreat-lead_ah02.

measurements.design: threat jobs, copies 1, 8 cohorts x 20 battles per threat, 2025 fillers. Threat variants are byte patches of the real opponents that change only the lattice: OH2 'mov dl,ah; inc dl' (88 E2 FE C2 at 91h and 13Dh) -> 'mov dl,N; nop; nop' (N=2,4,5,6,8,0Ah -> 82h,62h,52h,42h,22h,02h); zrl03 A/B FAR_SEG immediates F9h -> FBh (52h) / FCh (62h). Partner OH1 unchanged. Base team score per threat computed from the result files (scratch/B065/perthreat.cjs); across-threat comparisons are UNPAIRED (different fillers/seeds, SE ~0.03-0.06 each); candidate-vs-base diffs are paired.

OpcodeHunter.reading: Base does not score lower against undercutting OH variants (0.68-0.73) than against same/above variants (0.56-0.62); replicate OH_62 base scores 0.480 vs 0.617 show the unpaired spread is filler noise. The paired lat62 probe shows no lattice effect vs OH (all CIs straddle 0). The lat22 probe's losses in OH cohorts (-0.02 to -0.13) do not follow its lattice relation to OH (it loses most where it is the undercutter) and fit its general 2025-field cost (screen oauc2 2025 -0.026) plus noise.

threatFindings.threat: Agent-built peers zrl03/ah02 sit 20h below rev0 (FAR_SEG 0FF9h, 32h) and take points through the undercut
threatFindings.evidence: pn6t4: base 0.435 vs real zrl03 (32h), 0.528 vs zrl03 moved to 52h, 0.674 vs moved to 62h; zrl03 team 0.504/0.413/0.257; paired lat22 probe +0.136 [0.054,0.218] vs real zrl03 (matches B055 3mty0 +0.108). ah02 lattice static only.
threatFindings.impact: ~0.09/battle vs same-lattice counterfactual (~0.24 vs 10h-above) in cohorts containing zrl03/ah02; on field S only 3/50 cohorts -> ~0.005 on ALL; absent from official pools

threatFindings.threat: OpcodeHunter2 (2025 field, top point-taker) undercuts rev0 by 10h/30h/50h in 3 of 5 load positions
threatFindings.evidence: Mechanism present statically and in trace trail words (CS 0FF6-0FFE, IP A4). Measured cost ~0: base vs OH forced below 0.68-0.73 vs same/above 0.56-0.62 (lxcij, m58nr, f2kqk, unpaired); paired lat62 probe vs base f2kqk: OH_52 -0.039, OH_62 -0.003, OH_82 +0.029, all CIs include 0
threatFindings.impact: no measurable lattice-specific cost (|effect| < ~0.05/battle in OH cohorts)

threatFindings.threat: Other official 2025/2024 replicators undercut rev0 within the same MOVSB family
threatFindings.evidence: static scan lattice.txt + trailwords: in-family entries are at A2h, D2h, 62h, 6Ah (above/far); the 10h-60h-below window only contains MOVSW-type entries (SKYENT 41h, PastRAMa 11h/41h, Baltika9/TrojanByte 03h) whose threat is the B051 anchor kill, not the lattice undercut
threatFindings.impact: domain-5 prevalence in official pools ~1 team (OpcodeHunter)

threatFindings.threat: rev0 undercuts the 62h V6-family crowd (Chimera/m050, b01d, e1p4, FixedToggle, Synthesis, Registered_Winners)
threatFindings.evidence: static FAR_SEG 0FFCh in all; zrl03 moved to 62h drops to 0.257 vs base and base rises to 0.674 (pn6t4); B055 ppsmg lat_p10
threatFindings.impact: a protective asset; any lattice shift below 42h to escape zrl03 must keep 10h-60h below 62h

threatFindings.threat: Lattice relation rule (10h-60h below wins) generalizes beyond V6-geometry replicators
threatFindings.evidence: holds for zrl03 (V6/Chimera geometry, pn6t4) but not detected vs OpcodeHunter2 (different worker, 12-word copy, per-generation INT87; f2kqk)
threatFindings.impact: lattice threat should be assessed per family, not by lattice offset alone

recommendation: No promotion candidate (measurement role; probes not promising). The domain-5 weakness is real but narrow: in official 2025/2024 pools the only in-family undercutter is OpcodeHunter2 and its lattice costs nothing measurable; the measurable cost comes from agent-built peers zrl03/ah02 at 32h (~0.09/battle in their cohorts, ~0.005 on field S ALL). Do not shift the base lattice for this (B055: lat_m30 -0.026 on 2025); prefer targeted fixes such as B054 fix2steal that already gain vs zrl03/ah02.
